title: Proper base change over a finite extension
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, with $A=\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi$, and $I=(\varpi)$, using [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] of noetherian finite-dimensional schemes $X,Y,X',Y'$ on which $\ell$ is invertible. Assume $f$ and $f'$ are proper and that the geometric fibers of $f$ have dimension at most some $e\geq0$, as in [cor-weil-pbc-constructible-complete]. Use the raw rational categories $\Dbc(T,E)=\Dbc(T_{\Proet},A)[1/\varpi]$ of [def-weil-pbc-rational-category]. Denote by $Rf_*,Rf'_*,Lg^*,Lg'^*$ the rational extensions, as in [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport], of the integral direct images and completed pullbacks in that corollary. The specified rational exchange is the extension of its completed integral exchange. For every $K\in\Dbc(X,E)$ its component is an isomorphism
$$
 Lg^*Rf_*K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*Lg'^*K
 \quad\text{in }\Dbc(Y',E).
$$

proof.text: Every raw rational object retains an integral object. The extending spectral absolute value sends l to a number less than one. Since the chosen uniformizer generates the maximal ideal, l belongs to its span and vanishes in the first coefficient quotient. Thus N=l satisfies the positive annihilator and invertibility hypotheses of the integral corollary.

proof.text: Use pullback pasting with the specified Cartesian identification to identify each geometric fiber of f' with a geometric fiber of f, preserving bound e. The fiber of an identity map at a geometric point is the spectrum of its field, whose Krull dimension is zero (Mathlib ringKrullDim_eq_zero_of_field).

proof.text: Apply wfConstructible_complete from [def-wf-tensor-product] at each generating tuple: the canonical representative of an integral constructible object has invertible intrinsic Koszul unit. The round-trip coefficient isomorphism of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] identifies this transported unit with the original completed Koszul unit. Scalar restriction is exact and conservative by [lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction]; on derived categories it reflects isomorphisms by applying the homology comparison in each degree. The descended Koszul unit from [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] is natural, so its invertibility transfers along the coefficient-transported isomorphism between any representative and the canonical representative. Transfer back to the original coefficients. The equivalence towerComplete_iff_intrinsic of [def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback] therefore gives quotient-tower completeness for the integral constructible object.

proof.text: For a pullback h, apply [cor-weil-pbc-constructible-complete] to the square with vertical identities and horizontal maps h. Its source composite preserves membership, and pushId of [lemma-weil-pbc-completed-exchange-coherence] identifies that source with completed pullback. For a proper h, apply the corollary to the square with vertical maps h and horizontal identities; its target preserves membership. By step 3 and completedPullId of the coherence node, this target is isomorphic to direct image. The isomorphism-closure conclusion of [lem-weil-pbc-uniform-complete-triangulated] transports membership through these identifications. Steps 1 and 2 check all hypotheses, giving the four witnesses hRf, hRf', hLg, hLg'.

proof.text: Apply [cor-weil-pbc-constructible-complete] to the given square and integral object. Its component equation identifies the specified completed exchange with the image of its natural isomorphism under the full-subcategory inclusion. Hence that exact ambient arrow is invertible. Lift its isomorphism to the full integral subcategory using the four witnesses of step 4. Apply pbcRationalization from [def-weil-pbc-rational-category] to this isomorphism. Its hom is definitionally finiteExtensionRationalExchangeComponent. Functoriality maps both inverse equations to inverse equations, proving the assertion for every raw rational object, including zero and uniformizer-power torsion.
